content:
- Overestimate prices in bullish sentiment periods (positive sentiment > 0.10) — model tends to overshoot early in upward trends.
- Underestimate prices in bearish sentiment (negative sentiment < -0.30) — model fails to capture sharp downside reversals.
- Lag in price corrections: model often delays mean reversion by 2–3 days after sentiment shifts.
- Overshoot after spikes: model overreacts to short-term sentiment spikes, especially when sentiment drops sharply from +0.30 to -0.40.
- Horizon bias: 30-day forecasts consistently overestimate mid-term price peaks and underestimate late-term corrections.
- Sentiment-weighted adjustment: if sentiment > 0.20, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.0% for each day; if sentiment < -0.30, increase forecast by 0.5–1.0% for each day.
